jobs.title: Program Manager (One Year Term)
jobs.description:
**Salary Grade**
----------------

  

Case Western Reserve University is committed to providing a transparent estimate of the salary range available for this position at the time of its posting. The salary range is between $49,257 and $62,311, depending on qualifications, experience, department budgets, and industry data.


Employees receive more than just a paycheck. University employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare, retirement plans, tuition assistance, paid time off, and a winter recess.


**Job Description**
-------------------

  

POSITION OBJECTIVE


Our research in Alzheimer's disease aims to identify genetic factors associated with dementia, specifically Alzheimer's type. We are focused on increasing the representation of our study population by enrolling individuals from various ancestries. Through this, we seek to better understand the genetic underpinnings of memory loss and dementia. By collecting comprehensive data and biological samples, we will conduct genetic studies to identify potential genetic markers for dementia. The Program Manager will play a key role in managing these efforts, including participant recruitment, enrollment, and data oversight, while collaborating with study sites to ensure the success of recruitment and data collection initiatives. This is a full\-time, 1 year term position.

  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


* Identify and enroll eligible individuals and meet enrollment goals. Cultivate relationships with potential study participants; providing education, building trust and promoting interest in study activities. Work within human research protection processes: create and maintain appropriate protocol documents, confidentially and sensitively obtain and review family and medical histories and perform study specific interviews, instruments, and exams and identify, obtain and review appropriate medical records. Draw blood for genetic studies (training can be provided on the job). Prepare detailed participant exam reports for adjudication. Oversee and maintain complete research files and comprehensive databases including: consent forms, demographics, family and medical history forms and all other study specific forms and data. Document and maintain records to show effort that may not be reflected in enrollment numbers; events attended, sign\-ups, declines, phone calls, messages left, etc. Ensure compliance with IRB approved protocols and maintain data integrity. (70%)


* Collaborate with study leadership to create strategic approaches to identify and engage community and clinic partnerships. Build community partnerships through effective outreach efforts. Develop and implement community recruitment strategy and methods. Design and manage community events; reach out to various groups including but not limited to the Alzheimer's association, churches, community senior centers, social groups and caregiver support groups. Maintain open communication with physicians and office staff participating in the studies in the community. Working closely with the research staff, monitor and oversee research activities for the ascertainment, recruitment and enrollment of study participants for the DAWN study and ensure timelines and goals are met. Evaluate outreach efforts, identify areas for improvement, advise leadership of alternative methods/efforts, and implement adjustments. (10%)


* Facilitate communication and provide regular research updates for meetings. Work with the team to prepare a yearly participant newsletter. Participate in research group meetings locally and with the national network and communicate with the Research Project Director and Principal Investigators to ensure that work on the studies is being performed as needed and expected. Attend regular meetings locally and nationally with the principal investigators/coordinators and collaborators. Maintain open communication/collaboration between departments within and outside of institution. (10%)


* Provide training and instruction regarding enrollment and data entry procedures for others working on the study. (7%)

  

NONESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


* May serve as a co\-author on research publications. (1%)


* Provide training regarding enrollment and data entry procedures for others who work with the studies. May supervise students and technicians. (1%)


* Perform other duties as assigned. (1%)

  

CONTACTS


Department: On\-going contact with supervisor. Contact with Research Project Director and PI as needed, staff, faculty, postdocs, and study participants. Will work closely with any other team members who work on the same study, coordinate research activities for the ascertainment, recruitment, and enrollment of study participants for the human genetics research studies in their area.


University: Contact as needed with purchasing, human resources, space, and facilities planning, environmental health, safety/contact, Research Administration, IRB, and Sponsored Projects Accounting.


External: Regular contact with community leaders, collaborators at other universities, institutions, and industry. Occasional contact with vendors.


Students: On\-going contact with students.

  

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY


This position has no direct supervision of staff employees. May train new staff; direct the work of students.

  

QUALIFICATIONS


Experience 2 to 5 years of experience with minority community and familiarity with the aging population, preferably in the Cleveland area;


Education: Bachelor's degree required. Prefer Nursing degree. Must have and maintain a valid driver's license and be able to travel to participant homes, exam locations and community events, primarily within the local area.

  

REQUIRED SKILLS


* Ability to concisely and effectively communicate methods, concepts, and study designs to all groups as appropriate, relevant and indicated.


* Effective and professional interpersonal skills. Demonstrated expertise and strong leadership

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Husky TechnologiesTM is a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy.


Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky TechnologiesTM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM United States manufacturing facility is located in Milton, Vermont on a large, beautiful campus located just 30 minutes north of downtown Burlington, Vermont. Features include an onsite cafeteria, open office concept, fitness center, intramural sports activities and clean, state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment, competitive total compensation and attractive benefits package.  

  



Additional things you might like to know about working at Husky TechnologiesTM in Milton, Vermont;


* 200,000 square foot bright, clean machine shop
* Shift work premiums (25% afternoon shift and 40% evening shift)
* Annual incentive bonus
* Outstanding 401k contribution and match program
* 700 acres of private land to walk, bike, run or cross country ski
* On site gym facility
* On site cafeteria
* Opportunity to work for a world class company with great people

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!



Salary Range: 110k\-142k



Replacement



The Global Trade Compliance team operates across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions in close collaboration with Husky’s Legal department. The team defines, implements, and continuously improves processes and policies to ensure compliance with global export control, sanctions, and customs regulations.



As the Global Trade Compliance Program Manager, you will report to the Director, Global Trade Compliance \& Customs and serve as the program lead for enterprise\-wide trade compliance initiatives. This role will focus on managing global compliance projects, optimizing processes, and ensuring the successful integration of trade compliance requirements into Husky’s systems.



You will partner with cross\-functional teams—including Supply Chain, Engineering, IT, Finance, and Sales—to strengthen Husky’s global trade compliance framework, enhance operational efficiency, and reduce compliance risk across all regions.



Key Responsibilities



Program and Project Management



Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of global trade compliance initiatives, including process optimization, technology integration, and system enhancements.



Manage the implementation of trade compliance modules within the ERP system to ensure alignment with global regulatory requirements.



Establish and maintain project governance, milestones, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms for trade compliance programs.



Coordinate global stakeholders to ensure timely completion of key deliverables and consistent global deployment of compliance practices.



Regulatory Compliance and Oversight



Stay current on international trade laws, import regulations/tariffs, export control regulations, and sanctions programs applicable to Husky’s business activities.



Translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable business processes and internal controls.



Collaborate with Engineering and Legal teams to establish export control measures and export authorization processes globally.



Monitor the effectiveness of trade compliance procedures and implement corrective actions as needed.



Classification, Licensing, and Documentation



Lead efforts to standardize global product classification processes, including export control, HTS, and country\-of\-origin determinations.



Develop and maintain processes for end\-use/end\-user certifications, license applications, and transaction due diligence.



Ensure accuracy and consistency in trade data, documentation, and system configurations supporting export and customs compliance.



Risk Management and Continuous Improvement



Conduct global risk assessments and audits to evaluate compliance performance and identify improvement opportunities.



Develop risk mitigation strategies to prevent export control or import customs violations.



Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging digital tools and automation to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting.



Support internal investigations and voluntary disclosures, when applicable.



Training, Communication, and Stakeholder Engagement



Develop and deliver global training programs to increase awareness of export control, sanctions, and customs requirements.



Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross\-functional collaboration.



Partner with IT, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure trade compliance considerations are embedded in business processes.



Provide input in communications with government authorities and external consultants regarding trade compliance projects and i

jobs.title: Digital Accessibility Program Manager
jobs.description:
ArcSource Group, Inc. is an award\-winning, woman\-owned small business providing program and project management, business optimization, training development and delivery, digital accessibility, administrative, and information technology support services to federal civilian and defense customers for more than 20 years. ArcSource combines agile project management expertise and technical skills with innovative, effective solutions to help our customers achieve mission objectives. ArcSource’s commitment to delivering high\-quality services is demonstrated through its appraised processes and ISO certifications for quality and IT management.

We are seeking a **Digital Accessibility Program Manager** to support the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), Office of the Secretary (OS), Digital Accessibility Program.

As the Program Manager, this individual oversees contract performance, personnel, deliverables, governance, stakeholder coordination, resource allocation, risk management, and service quality. As the program’s Solutions Architect, this individual directly leads and performs the technical architecture, solution design, systems integration, web\-crawler strategy, data integration, automation, and technical\-improvement activities.

Position Location: Remote/telework

Clearance Level Required: None

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Program Management**

* Manage and coordinate all core and optional contract activities, ensuring performance remains aligned with HHS Digital Accessibility Program objectives and Government priorities.
* Develop, maintain, and execute the Project Management Plan and supporting Communications, Risk, Scope, Change, and Quality Management Plans.
* Manage contract deliverables, schedules, quality requirements, Government review cycles, priorities, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Manage contractor resource assignments and workload priorities, align staffing with Government needs, and matrix resources across task areas to prevent single points of failure.
* Collaborate with Government personnel to establish and maintain key performance indicators; monitor performance and emerging trends; and recommend corrective actions and process improvements based on performance data.
* Maintain program governance, work breakdown structure, and backlog oversight, strategic planning, the program roadmap, risk and issue management, program records, and program\-maturity documentation.
* Coordinate with Government stakeholders regarding priorities, dependencies, risks, strategic objectives, and resource needs; facilitate executive\-level communications and decision\-making; and identify and escalate significant program risks and issues.
* Plan and conduct Quarterly Program Management Reviews or Quarterly Business Reviews and communicate program status, performance, risks, issues, and decisions to Government and executive stakeholders.

**Technical Solution Architecture**

* Directly provide technical architecture and solution\-design leadership across the HHS Digital Accessibility Program.
* Assess program requirements and recommend technical solutions, tools, integrations, workflows, and automation opportunities.
* Support the administration and optimization of the enterprise accessibility web crawler, including its configuration, scanning strategies, integrations, calibration, and governance.
* Collaborate with accessibility testers to evaluate automated scan results, resolve false positives or inconsistencies, and improve scan calibration.
* Ensure technical solutions support applicable Section 508 and WCAG Level AA accessibility requirements.
* Design scalable approaches for collecting, integrating, analyzing, and reporting accessibility program data from service requests, testing results, web\-crawler outputs, helpdesk activities, and other program sources.
* Support the appropriate integration of artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural\-language processing, dashboards, and automation into accessibility operations.
* Provide technical guidance supporting Digital Accessibility Solution Center operations and embedded accessibility SME services.
* Identify technology risks, integration dependencies, technical constraints, and opportunities for modernization.
* Develop or contribute to technical standards, operating procedures, governance documentation, user guides, and solution roadmaps.
* Collaborate with HHS stakeholders, vendors, accessibility specialists, analysts, and program personnel to recommend sustainable technical solutions.
* Support the development and continued improvement of customer\-facing digital accessibility tools and Microsoft 365 or SharePoint\-based capabilities when required.
* Participate directly in technical troubleshooting and the escalation of significant tool, platform, or service issues.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in digital accessibility, solution architecture, systems integration, technical program management, and Federal program management.
* Current DHS Trusted Tester certification.
* Expert knowledge of Section 508, WCAG AA, DHS Trusted Tester methodology, and Federal digital accessibility requirements.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Federal contract and program management, including governance, performance management, risk, scope, change, quality, communications, KPI development, resource management, and executive stakeholder engagement.
* Enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, accessibility testing and monitoring platforms, web crawling, and automated accessibility scanning.
* Microsoft 365, SharePoint, project\-tracking tools, data architecture, analytics, dashboards, reporting, workflow automation, and process improvement.
* Application of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and natural\-language processing to operational data.
